name: scrapekit
description: Proactive web scraping and document extraction router. Routes fetch/scrape tasks across webclaw, trafilatura, jina, playwright, tavily, apify, docling, searxng, and firecrawl based on source type, cost, and complexity.

interface.shortDescription: Smart web scraping router — picks the cheapest/fastest tool for any URL or doc type.
interface.longDescription: scrapekit is a proactive routing layer for web scraping and document extraction. It automatically selects the best tool (webclaw, trafilatura, jina, playwright, apify, docling, firecrawl, searxng, browser-harness, tavily) based on content type, cost, and complexity. Handles articles, SPAs, PDFs, social media, e-commerce, YouTube, and login-gated pages. Always tries local free tools first, escalates to external APIs only on failure.
defaultPrompt: Scrape this page and extract the main content
Fetch this URL and convert it to markdown
Search the web for recent news about X
Scrape the Instagram profile at this URL
